layers.name: Jubilee Sensing & Alerting
layers.cadence: Preserve working overnight cadence; bounded daytime retrospective reconciliation without a duplicate verifier task.

layers.name: Jubilee Dawn Forecast
layers.timing_rationale: Allows the local coordinator to publish the first completed burst captured at/after dawn and, if that burst remains too dark, the dawn+20-minute daylight follow-up before the principal visual assessment.
layers.coverage_preserved: Pre-daybreak human-search, light, weather and environmental sensing remains active under Jubilee Sensing & Alerting; this schedule change does not remove that coverage or alter alert thresholds.

observed_weather_input.rule: Re-evaluate observed_at_utc age against sensor_contract weather freshness and require available_at <= issue time. UNKNOWN for stale/missing/QC-rejected values; blank precipitation is never zero. Refresh selectively if needed. Airport observations are regional context, not local shoreline wind/rain. Do not copy previously saved KNOWN status without issue-time validation.

dawn_horizon_policy.guardrail: Only an existing three-day horizon with identical daily heuristic ranges, central estimates and confidence may roll forward without numerical reassessment. Otherwise REVIEW_REQUIRED. Sensing and Dawn Timing do not own this reassessment.

subordinate_jobs.github_sensing_quality: Regression tests, metadata integrity and full environmental forcing every three hours. River also refreshes in the lightweight ASOS job; not a fifth independent forecast model.
subordinate_jobs.github_water_quality: Existing weekly historical ingest and diagnostics; zero production weight. No duplicate full historical download on every sensing cycle.
subordinate_jobs.windows_capture: One device-acquisition service with separately versioned live and canonical-burst products; integration pending local tests.
subordinate_jobs.github_asos_weather: Official AWC KBFM/KMOB METAR and qualified USGS lower-river refresh at minute 07 UTC and on main status.json camera publications, plus sensing-quality ingestion. Camera push is a fallback for delayed/dropped cron, not a new camera schedule. Public context only; shared sensing concurrency and producer-outcome publication guards retained. No model/weight/alert, freshness-limit or dawn-schedule changes.

migration_acceptance: Inspect existing task IDs and schedules; change the existing tasks rather than create duplicates.
Back up task configuration and local code before edits.
Verify replacement output and one actual scheduled run before disabling predecessors.
End the temporary weekend sprint after its acceptance report, not merely when the date passes.
Record each migration as APPLIED_AND_TESTED, APPLIED_NOT_TESTED, or NOT_APPLIED.

forecast_governance.probability_reporting: Distinguish heuristic judgment from empirically calibrated probability; never invent precision.
